payload.description_html:
Fig 20. Contemptor mastinoi n. gen. et n. sp.
Lateral view in natural light of the holotype, IGVR 82435-82436 (A-B), detail of the cranium of IGVR 82345 coated in alcohol (C). Lateral view of the paratype, IGVR 67858, coated in alcohol (D) and of the specimen IGVR 64080a-b in natural light (E-F). Scale bars 20 mm (A-B, D-F), 10 mm (C).
